tha-ap308:1.1: Sampasādaka.] Namo te buddhavīr' atthu vippamutto si sabbadhi / vyasanam hi anuppatto tassa me saraṇaṃ bhava. // //
tha-ap308:2.1: Siddhattho tassa vyākāsi loke appaṭipuggalo: / ‘mahodadhisamo saṅgho appameyyo anuttaro. // //
tha-ap308:3.1: Tattha tvaṃ viraje khette anantaphaladāyake / saṅghe cittaṃ pasādehi sukhī bījañ ca ropaya.' // //
tha-ap308:4.1: Idaṃ vatvāna sabbaññū lokajeṭṭho narāsabho / mam evam anusāsitvā vehāsaṃ nabham uggami. // //
tha-ap308:5.1: Aciraṃ gatamaggamhi sabbaññumhi narāsabhe / maraṇaṃ samanuppatto Tusitam upapajj' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap308:6.1: Tadāhaṃ viraje khette anantaphaladāyake / saṅghe cittaṃ pasādetvā kappaṃ saggamhi mod' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap308:7.1: Catunavute ito kappe pasādam alabhiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pasādassa idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap308:9.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Sampasādiko thero i. g. a-ti.
